name: Meteor Storm
storyline:
Set in the vastness of space, players navigate the Thalcian Spacer, defending against relentless meteor storms and alien invaders known as the Xxkraan Raiders.

The storyline unfolds as players investigate an ancient artifact of the People of Sphere, hidden within a Trans-dimensional field. Just as the artifact is about to be unlocked, a meteor storm, manipulated by the Xxkraan Raiders, threatens the mission.
summary: Players must skillfully maneuver their spacecraft, utilizing X-ray lasers to destroy meteors and alien saucers.
